title: ConvertTimeZoneResponse
description: Response schema for the TimezoneDB convert-time-zone endpoint. Returns converted timestamps and metadata for source and destination timezones.

message.description: Error message; empty string if successful.

fromZoneName.description: IANA timezone name of the origin timezone.

fromAbbreviation.description: Timezone abbreviation of the origin timezone.

fromTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the origin time.

toZoneName.description: IANA timezone name of the destination timezone.

toAbbreviation.description: Timezone abbreviation of the destination timezone.

toTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the equivalent time in the destination timezone.

offset.description: Difference in seconds between origin timezone and destination timezone. Positive means destination is ahead of origin.
